Section III. Objectives and results chain

Objectives: 1. Better understanding of the attractiveness/repulsiveness mechanisms for mosquitoes of both
sexes at different physiological ages to achieve technical outcomes 1 and 3.

2. Development and validation of innovative sexing methods to achieve technical outcome 1.

3. Development and testing of new entomological indicators that have proven links with disease transmission
to achieve technical outcome 2.

4. Development of trapping systems and baits for improved monitoring of the mosquito dynamics of both
sexes to achieve technical objective 3.
